description: Machine-checkable form of the required-update matrix in documentation-governance.md. Each rule fires when a changed file matches `when` but none of `expect` also changed, and prints an advisory (see scripts/check-currency.mjs). Advisory by design: a rule can be legitimately skipped, so this nudges rather than blocks. Globs support `*` (within a path segment) and `**` (any segments).

rules.label: Product capability or maturity
rules.message: Capability catalogue changed — run `npm run dashboard` to re-sync the evidence trace and dashboard artifacts.

rules.label: JS lending policy ↔ Rust differential corpus
rules.message: Eligibility policy changed — regenerate the differential corpus: `node rules/tools/gen-eligibility-corpus.mjs`. CI also enforces this as a hard gate.

rules.label: Demo seed, deployment, artifact, domain, mock, persona or operating flow
rules.message: AWS demo surface changed — review the showcase architecture, demo handbook and current-implementation map (AGENTS.md non-negotiable).

rules.label: Architecture or service boundary (decision engine)
rules.message: Engine crate changed — confirm the INV/DEC/SEC/PH tables in decision-engine-design.md still describe the code (cite IDs in the commit).

rules.label: Repository layout, command or agent rule
rules.message: Commands, CI or orchestration changed — update the Commands / rules section of AGENTS.md if the change is agent-facing.
